title: Post Archetype
description: Channel-owned, extensible semantic content format (e.g. 'product-promotion', 'medical-news'). Deliberately NOT a closed global enum: each channel maintains its own post-archetypes.json under channels/<slug>/content/. Post Archetype != publishing shape (SINGLE_POST|CAROUSEL|REEL, computed by channel-content-os), != canvas format (FEED_TALL_PORTRAIT etc.), != density, != narrativeStructure -- those are all derived facts about a specific piece of real content, never this channel-curated label.
